terms.adaptive_alpha: A local lookup policy that changes alpha/beta/timeout/family requirements from recent transcript pressure rather than hard-coding constant concurrency.
terms.budget_receipt: A signed garden statement that binds useful refusal/throttle/prioritization to a sweep audit digest; evidence, not currency or reputation.
terms.cache_poison: Repeated-round pressure where replayed transcripts or captured fast windows reinforce stale or misleading cached witness evidence.
terms.captured_fast_window: A lookup condition where the earliest replies are dominated by one captured family even if the full candidate set appears diverse.
terms.claim_debt: A claim-adjacent area needing tests, evidence, or narrower wording.
terms.classic_bridge: An optional garden service that translates classic-client requests into DHT lookups without becoming an authority.
terms.contact_card: A compact signed entrance object carrying I2P Destination, DHT public key, derived node id, capabilities, expiry, and bootstrap hints.
terms.contact_lease: A short-lived signed reachability/entrance statement with monotonic sequence memory; local freshness evidence, not global identity truth.
terms.custody_receipt: A signed garden statement that an exact record digest was accepted under a bounded custody window; evidence, not durable truth.
terms.garden_node: A voluntary high-resource giving node that contributes capacity without becoming truth authority.
terms.garden_scheduler: A local multi-window admission/refusal planner for garden work that protects head-watch, witness-query, and seed-gate functions.
terms.head_witness: A local or garden observation about mutable head sequence, digest, and source.
terms.historical_legacy_import: A legacy import retained to preserve old behavior evidence, distinct from a new active caller that should be migrated.
terms.i2p_only_mode: A default-off mode that starts from DHT/I2P entrances and does not silently log in to classic servers.
terms.keyspace_cartography: A local XOR-prefix memory of observed regions, holes, stale areas, family monoculture, and scout needs; not a global map.
terms.lease_quorum: Local entrance portfolio pressure over contact leases, source families, path families, and purpose coverage; not consensus.
terms.liveness_budget: A local budget joining adaptive lookup pressure with provider probe metadata spend so liveness does not silently increase raw-key exposure or query fanout.
terms.lookup_transcript: A transport-neutral local evidence object for DHT lookup events, path families, timings, payload digests, and pressure decisions.
terms.mutable_head: A mutable slot whose value points to a newer content-addressed object, feed tip, roster digest, manifest root, or torrent infohash.
terms.mutable_slot: Signed Ed25519/salt/seq DHT value with monotonic updates.
terms.per_writer_feed: Append-only signed sequence owned by one writer key; used as the preferred multiwriter sync shape.
terms.policy_capsule: A signed, expiring, scoped policy list that a client or bridge may subscribe to for warnings/refusals; not protocol truth.
terms.policy_epoch_head: A signed mutable pointer that binds a namespace policy digest to a monotonic epoch and optional previous-head digest; local observation, not global governance.
terms.policy_fold: The rev0024 audit/refactor surface that keeps policy epoch, range Merkle, and queue forge paths visible.
terms.policy_portfolio: A signed mutable head containing references to subjective policy capsules.
terms.private_provider_probe: A budgeted provider semantic-confirmation attempt that may include decoys, family caps, and commitment-only witness surfaces; not private retrieval.
terms.probe_witness: A signed local/garden/sentinel observation about a provider, mutable head, or path. Evidence, not truth.
terms.provider_compat: The explicit mapping from legacy providerpoison.py names to canonical reexports, adapters, historical-only constants, or manual decisions before wrapper/deletion work.
terms.provider_record: Signed claim that a node can provide content or service for a key.
terms.provider_surface_migration: Audit-visible process for migrating historical providerpoison.py callers toward canonical provider_poison.py or explicit adapters.
terms.provider_surface_refactor: The audit-mapped migration from legacy providerpoison.py toward canonical provider_poison.py without deleting historical context.
terms.queueforge: A deterministic garden admission queue planner for latency, reserve-slot, family-flood, and useful-refusal pressure.
terms.range_merkle_fixture: A toy Merkle range root/proof surface used to request exact repair without treating roots as truth.
terms.region_ledger: Garden-local memory for reprovide/sweep work grouped by XOR region with source-family pressure, tombstone suppression, and batch-weight limits.
terms.route_gossip: Local exchange of route contacts for repairing stale DHT memory; repair signal, not truth authority.
terms.sam_garden: A SAM shadow transcript family for future garden-node behavior: outbound connect, inbound accept, reconnect, naming failure, and datagram assumption probes.
terms.sam_shadow: A no-network SAM transcript fixture used to test integration assumptions before live I2P transport.
terms.same_sequence_fork: Two valid-looking mutable head values at the same sequence with different value digests.
terms.seed_portfolio: A signed mutable head containing compact references to contact cards for bootstrap diversity.
terms.sibling_broadcast: A family-diverse storage/replication pressure surface that treats signed store receipts as evidence rather than durable truth.
terms.siblingcast: A sibling storage planning and exact-digest acknowledgement surface for STORE/ANNOUNCE work near a DHT target.
terms.soverseed: The guess that central/classic clients can seed sovereignty by exchanging DHT contact cards while the central path still works.
terms.store_flight: Garden-local STORE admission, eviction, tombstone/bad-proof quarantine, and signed custody-receipt pressure for small DHT records.
terms.substrate_dht: The generic DHT that runs above I2P and below future application consumers.
terms.surface_clean: An active surface hygiene audit for revision/import drift that preserves historical docs while checking live metadata.
terms.surface_ledger: A compact active module/test/doc ledger used to distinguish current implementation surfaces from historical wake-from-amnesia material.
terms.sweep_audit: A local audit of region-ledger reprovide plans for weight, source-family monoculture, and tombstone priority before gardens spend bandwidth.
terms.tombstone_cache: A local cache of signed withdrawal/deletion/revocation/compromise evidence that blocks stale resurrection pressure without claiming global deletion truth.
terms.tombstone_mesh: A local judgment surface combining live tombstones, witness summaries, and mutable-head events to block or repair resurrection pressure without global deletion truth.
terms.useful_refusal_backoff: The rule that useful refusals are liveness/capacity evidence that should slow callers rather than trigger floods.
terms.wire_transcript_fixture: A signed transport-neutral sequence of frames used to test canonicalization before live I2P/SAM transport.
terms.witness_cache: A local cache of signed witness receipts with aging, duplicate collapse, family caps, and contradiction quarantine; evidence, not quorum.
terms.witness_repair: Bounded local next actions derived from weak, stale, or contradictory witness-cache summaries.
